entries.note: Every row is a plain button or label under a per-action id push, so no shared microui pool is involved (the treenode pool abort of spec 074's review must not recur). Unavailable actions are labels, never buttons, so a click cannot request something the service would refuse; the first missing item is named inline. Clicks hand off to app.c (run/capture/reveal) which owns every request; the tab's data is the service listing itself, refreshed on demand.
